problem_text:
A regional water quality monitoring network must schedule a technician to collect samples from 11 distinct testing stations.

The travel times between stations, measured in minutes, are as follows:
* Station P to Q: 143.2 minutes
* Station P to R: 40.0 minutes
* Station P to S: 157.1 minutes
* Station P to T: 120.7 minutes
* Station P to U: 105.5 minutes
* Station P to V: 111.3 minutes
* Station P to W: 60.1 minutes
* Station P to X: 19.2 minutes
* Station P to Y: 117.8 minutes
* Station P to Z: 38.9 minutes
* Q to R: 170.7 minutes
* Q to S: 167.7 minutes
* Q to T: 29.6 minutes
* Q to U: 113.8 minutes
* Q to V: 97.0 minutes
* Q to W: 111.0 minutes
* Q to X: 128.4 minutes
* Q to Y: 211.6 minutes
* Q to Z: 134.1 minutes
* R to S: 141.4 minutes
* R to T: 152.1 minutes
* R to U: 103.4 minutes
* R to V: 115.1 minutes
* R to W: 100.0 minutes
* R to X: 58.8 minutes
* R to Y: 81.3 minutes
* R to Z: 38.9 minutes
* S to T: 173.6 minutes
* S to U: 62.6 minutes
* S to V: 73.6 minutes
* S to W: 190.0 minutes
* S to X: 163.1 minutes
* S to Y: 101.5 minutes
* S to Z: 118.2 minutes
* T to U: 114.2 minutes
* T to V: 100.1 minutes
* T to W: 82.5 minutes
* T to X: 104.2 minutes
* T to Y: 202.6 minutes
* T to Z: 118.2 minutes
* U to V: 18.4 minutes
* U to W: 129.0 minutes
* U to X: 107.0 minutes
* U to Y: 105.6 minutes
* U to Z: 69.3 minutes
* V to W: 125.9 minutes
* V to X: 109.6 minutes
* V to Y: 123.9 minutes
* V to Z: 78.3 minutes
* W to X: 41.2 minutes
* W to Y: 174.1 minutes
* W to Z: 84.5 minutes
* X to Y: 134.1 minutes
* X to Z: 47.9 minutes
* Y to Z: 91.1 minutes

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient inspection circuit whereby the technician visits every station precisely once before returning to the initial point of departure.
